qc.label_under_test: the word pieces 'withstanding' (in 'Notwithstanding') and '-based' (in compounds like 'evidence-based'), with weaker firing on some intensifying adjectives

neighbours.label: a short list of exact English word pieces: '-based' (X-based compounds), 'withstanding' (in 'Notwithstanding'), ' accompany' and ' exceptionally'; not their relatives (-driven, accompanied, exceptional, despite)
fire: The startup built a cloud-based platform for small clinics.
Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the parade went ahead as planned.
Parents must accompany children under twelve at the pool.
The harvest was exceptionally good this year.
Our evidence-based approach reduced hospital readmissions.
Notwithstanding his objections, the committee approved the budget.
A short video will accompany each chapter of the online course.
She played exceptionally well in the final match.
quiet: The startup built a cloud-driven platform for small clinics.
Despite the heavy rain, the parade went ahead as planned.
Children under twelve were accompanied by parents at the pool.
The harvest was exceptional this year.
Our data-driven approach reduced hospital readmissions.
Despite his objections, the committee approved the budget.
A short video was included with each chapter of the online course.
She played remarkably well in the final match.
